metadata.title: Create Response Parser for AI Output

story.iWant: Parse and validate OpenAI JSON responses for betting analysis
story.soThat: I can extract structured probability data for edge detection calculation
story.tasks: - Parse OpenAI JSON response format (markets array with probabilities, reasoning, confidence) - Extract probabilities for all markets (match_result, total_goals, corners, cards) - Validate probability values are floats in range [0.0, 1.0] - Normalize multi-outcome market probabilities to sum to 1.0 - Handle malformed responses gracefully (missing fields, invalid JSON, type errors) - Attach parsed analysis to fixture.ai_analysis field (replace raw response) - Create validated MarketAnalysis objects - Implement comprehensive logging and error handling

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/ai/response_parser.py` module 2. Parse OpenAI JSON response format (markets array with probabilities, reasoning, confidence) 3. Extract probabilities for all markets (match_result, total_goals, corners, cards) 4. Validate probability values are floats in range [0.0, 1.0] 5. Normalize multi-outcome market probabilities to sum to 1.0 6. Handle malformed responses gracefully (missing fields, invalid JSON, type errors) 7. Attach parsed analysis to fixture.ai_analysis field (replace raw response) 8. Create validated MarketAnalysis objects with: type, ai_probability dict, reasoning, confidence

artifact.title: Technical Specification
artifact.snippet: Prompt strategy and response format specification. Input JSON with fixture/form/injuries/odds. Output JSON with markets array containing probabilities, reasoning, confidence fields for match_result, total_goals, corners, cards markets.

artifact.title: Data Dictionary
artifact.snippet: Defines OpenAI probability estimates fields: ai_analysis_timestamp, ai_model, market-specific probabilities (match_result_home/draw/away_prob, total_goals_over_prob, etc.), reasoning strings. Validation rules require 0.0-1.0 float values.

artifact.title: Story 4.1: Build OpenAI Prompt Builder (APPROVED)
artifact.snippet: Expected JSON response from OpenAI: {"markets": [{"type": "match_result", "probabilities": {"home": 0.55, "draw": 0.25, "away": 0.20}, "reasoning": "...", "confidence": 0.85}]}. Parser must handle this exact structure and validate all fields.

artifact.title: Story 4.2: Integrate OpenAI API Client (DONE)
artifact.section: Dev Notes - Response Format and Client Output (lines 191-201)
artifact.snippet: Story 4.2 creates OpenAI client that receives JSON responses and attaches raw response to fixture.ai_analysis field. Story 4.3 parser receives this raw response and must parse/validate it, extracting structured MarketAnalysis objects. Error handling pattern: never crash, mark fixture with error_message if parsing completely fails.

artifact.reason: Core Pydantic v2 model that must be populated by parser. Has fields: market_type (str), ai_probability (float 0.0-1.0), reasoning (str), confidence (int 0-100). Parser creates instances of this model from OpenAI response.

Container model for list of MarketAnalysis objects. Parser creates AIAnalysis object with markets[] array and attaches to fixture.ai_analysis field. Has fields: fixture_id, markets (list of MarketAnalysis), analysis_timestamp, model_used.

Main data model that parser augments. Has ai_analysis field (AIAnalysis) and error_message field (str|None). Parser receives fixture with raw ai_analysis JSON response, parses it, and returns fixture with structured MarketAnalysis objects attached.

Story 4.2 module that creates raw OpenAI responses. Parser is called downstream by Story 4.4 batch analyzer to process fixture.ai_analysis responses from this function. Client returns fixture with raw JSON response; parser refines this to structured models.
Story 4.1 upstream module. Documents expected response format that parser must handle. Response format defined in Story 4.1 is the contract parser must validate against.

Custom exception hierarchy for error handling. Parser uses these for structured error handling. APIError for API failures, DataValidationError for invalid probability values or response structure issues.

constraint.title: Response Format Contract (from Story 4.1)
constraint.description: Must handle exact JSON format from OpenAI: {"markets": [{"type": "...", "probabilities": {...}, "reasoning": "...", "confidence": number}]}. Any deviation should be handled gracefully with logging, never crash.

constraint.title: Probability Validation (from Data Dictionary)
constraint.description: All probability values must be floats in range [0.0, 1.0]. Multi-outcome markets (match_result: 3 outcomes) must sum to ~1.0 with tolerance ±0.05 for floating-point rounding. Normalize if sum deviates.

constraint.title: Error Handling Strategy (from CLAUDE.md)
constraint.description: Never raise exceptions from parse functions. Use custom exception hierarchy (APIError, DataValidationError). Return error status instead of raising. Log all errors with fixture_id for traceability. Graceful degradation: continue processing if one market fails, skip bad markets, return partial results.

constraint.title: Python 3.14+ Compliance (from CLAUDE.md)
constraint.description: Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) NOT deprecated utcnow(). Modern type hints: list[X], dict[K,V], X|None. F-strings for formatting. Pydantic v2 syntax (field_validator, ConfigDict). All functions have explicit return types including None.

constraint.title: Async Pattern Enforcement (from CLAUDE.md)
constraint.description: Mark main functions async (build_analysis_prompt pattern). Use asyncio.gather() for parallel parsing if multiple fixtures. Use asyncio.timeout() for timeout enforcement. Proper cleanup in finally blocks. Never block event loop.

constraint.title: Module Structure (from Story 4.3 spec)
constraint.description: Create response_parser.py in src/bet_bot/analysis/ai/ directory. Export public functions from __init__.py: parse_openai_response, attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture. Use underscore prefix for internal helpers: _validate_market_probabilities, _normalize_probabilities, _parse_market, _validate_openai_response_structure, _extract_market_probabilities.

constraint.title: Data Flow Integration (from technical-spec)
constraint.description: Input: Fixture from Story 4.2 with fixture.ai_analysis = raw JSON response string. Parser must extract and validate JSON, create MarketAnalysis objects, attach to fixture. Output: Fixture with fixture.ai_analysis = AIAnalysis (structured) or fixture.error_message if parsing fails. Ready for Story 4.4 batch analyzer.

interface.name: parse_openai_response
interface.signature: async def parse_openai_response(response_json: str | dict, fixture_id: str) -> list[MarketAnalysis] | None
interface.description: Main entry point. Parses raw OpenAI JSON response (or dict) and validates structure. Returns list of MarketAnalysis objects or None if parsing fails completely. All errors logged with fixture_id context.

interface.name: attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture
interface.signature: async def attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture(fixture: Fixture, parsed_markets: list[MarketAnalysis]) -> Fixture
interface.description: Attaches parsed analysis to fixture. Creates AIAnalysis object with markets list, adds metadata (analysis_timestamp, model_used), and updates fixture.ai_analysis field. Returns augmented fixture ready for Story 4.4 EV calculation.

interface.name: parse_all_fixture_responses
interface.description: Batch orchestrator. Iterates through fixtures, parses each response, handles individual failures gracefully. Returns all fixtures with parsed analysis (or error_message if failed). Logs progress and summary. Called by Story 4.4.

interface.name: _validate_openai_response_structure
interface.description: Validates response has required keys: "markets" (array), each market has "type", "probabilities", "reasoning", "confidence". Returns bool. Logs validation failures at WARNING level.

interface.name: _validate_market_probabilities
interface.description: Validates all probability values are floats in [0.0, 1.0]. For multi-outcome markets (match_result), checks sum ≈ 1.0 (±0.05). Returns bool. Logs failures with market type and values.

interface.name: _normalize_probabilities
interface.description: Normalizes probabilities if sum != 1.0 by dividing by sum. Handles division by zero (all zeros case). Clips out-of-range values to [0.0, 1.0]. Logs normalization at DEBUG level. Returns normalized dict.

tests.standards: Python testing standards per CLAUDE.md: pytest framework for unit and integration tests. Use pytest.mark.asyncio for async functions. Pydantic v2 model validation testing. Test both valid paths and error cases. Graceful degradation testing: partial failures, invalid JSON, missing fields should be handled without crashing. Error message verification. Logging validation at appropriate levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

tests.ideas: - Test JSON parsing (valid/invalid/missing "markets" key) → AC #2, #6 - Test probability validation (valid range [0.0-1.0], multi-outcome sum) → AC #4, #5 - Test probability normalization (sum < 1.0, sum > 1.0, all zeros) → AC #5 - Test market extraction (all market types, missing fields, defaults) → AC #3, #6 - Test error handling (malformed response, type errors, missing fields) → AC #6 - Test batch parsing (multiple fixtures, failure handling) → AC #2, #6 - Test edge cases (empty markets array, probability as strings, very small probabilities, confidence edge cases) → AC #4, #8 - Test MarketAnalysis object creation and validation → AC #8 - Test fixture attachment and error_message population → AC #7 - Target: 85%+ code coverage for response_parser.py
